bio_en: Ninish Stepanian was born in Tehran in 1886, the daughter of Serob Khan Amirkhanian of Shamakhi, chief of lighting at the Persian royal palace. She studied in Paris in 1900-04 and, back in Tehran, took an active part in the newly organised Armenian youth life, joining the ARF in 1903. In 1909 she married Dr Harutiun Stepanian, with whom she was photographed beside Ruben Ter-Minasian in Tabriz in 1921. In 1928 she helped reorganise the Tehran Red Cross into the Armenian Women's Benevolent Society, and she died on 4 April 1954.
